text:
pagerduty: [ALERT] edge-gateway: 5xx error-rate > 5% (502/503 spike) - triggered 2026-03-14T04:12:01Z
incident-bot: page fired -> oncall: Lee (oncall)
Lee (oncall): Acked pagerduty. I'm on it, starting triage.
Maria G: seeing the same in eu-west1 (dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/edge/5xx-rate)
Samir: 5xx rate jumped from ~0.5% to ~8% in ~90s across edge proxies. Looks like a downstream cascade.
Lee (oncall): Any recent deploys to edge? Could be proxy change.
Aj Patel: there was a minor proxy config pushed at 03:58 (edge-proxy v2.7.4). I can revert if needed.
Danielle: CS: two large customers reported timeouts; support tickets opened and alerted.
incident-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/edge-5xx-cascade - step 1: ack, step 2: isolate, step 3: failover
Lee (oncall): starting isolation -> will pull traffic from eu-west1 and rollback proxy in staging first.
Samir: pulling a few recent logs from proxy pods, snippet:
```
[04:11:59Z] proxy: upstream read error: EOF
[04:12:00Z] proxy: 502 Bad Gateway - downstream queue full
[04:12:01Z] cache-node-7: eviction spikes, memory pressure
```
Maria G: cache nodes show OOM events around 04:11:50Z in eu-west1. Could be cascading evictions causing upstream timeouts.
Aj Patel: initiating rollback to v2.7.3: `kubectl -n edge rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy --to-revision=42`
Lee (oncall): also shifting traffic away from eu-west1 -> warm-pool in us-west to reduce load: `curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/route -d '{"target":"warm-pool"}'`
Samir: after the rollback + warm-pool cutover 5xx rate trending down to ~1.4% in last 60s :thumbsup:
pagerduty: alert acknowledged by Lee (oncall)
Danielle: CS update posted: impacted customers notified, offer retry/backoff guidance and ETA ~30m for full recovery.
Maria G: creating follow-up ticket ENG-4321 assigned to eng-runtime for RCA and capacity hardening.
Lee (oncall): documenting timeline in incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/1849004321 - adding commands run and observed metrics.
Aj Patel: leaving note: rollback performed due to proxy config changes correlating with OOMs on cache nodes.
Samir: taking ownership for RCA and postmortem. I'll gather telemetry (heap profiles, kernel logs, request traces).
Lee (oncall): Handoff -> Samir (eng-runtime) taking lead. I need to sign off in 30m; please ping if error rate creeps back >2%.
Samir: ack, I'll coordinate postmortem and severity assessment. CS has list of affected customers linked in the incident doc.
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated; paging suppressed; monitor window 30m; auto-escalate if 5xx > 2%
Lee (oncall): thanks team. Closing pager and adding on-call notes. :white_check_mark:
